what: In the next round, after the re-lock: cargo update -p getrandom@0.4.2 (to 0.4.3). getrandom 0.4.3 has no wasip2/wasip3 dependency, so wasip3 0.4, wit-bindgen 0.51, wit-bindgen-core/-rust/-rust-macro, wit-component, wit-parser, wasm-metadata and wasm-encoder/wasmparser 0.244 leave the lock. Also re-lock crates/blaze-wasm (excluded; its manifest now asks for wasm-encoder/wasmparser 0.263).
